verdict.rationale: mise documents installing prebuilt binaries rather than building them. Its github, aqua and http backends pull release artifacts per platform with checksums (mise-docs-4, mise-docs-26, mise-docs-54, mise-docs-57), its own Homebrew implementation installs formulae and casks (mise-docs-38), and a user reports replacing manual GitHub-release binary downloads with it (mise-comm-9). The only documented cache is mise-action's default tool caching, which is CI-only (mise-docs-96). Missing for 10: a documented local or shared binary cache, explicit precompiled installs for runtimes like Python/Ruby instead of source builds, and independent evidence of speed gains over compiling.
